property.name: Flavor
property.value: This system is running an older version of the software. The sludge it manages, however, resists its pull, and has swamped the data. It will be very difficult to clean.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: The SecurityCube for StarNet. It won't open without its P-Code!

property.name: Flavor
property.value: This teleporter won't work. Thankfully, the navi involved has not scared off the area.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: This teleport won't open. Arid heat spews from around it. The fires might be coming from here.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A commercial digi-server. Limited edition, high operating power, clever design. Though it does not look any different, it does not even hum.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: This specific digi-server powers up the two sites at once. It emits a squeaky straining beep.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A digi-server with data-scattering properties. If it shorts out, another will take over its duty.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: Someone must hate this digi-server. It's been vandalized, and kicked.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: Even in this area, there are digi-servers. Their ultimate purpose is uncertain, although they allow for a lot of data to interweave between dimensions.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: Strangely, this digi-server is in the middle of a platform, with no apparent purpose.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: It might not be long, but this digi-server, damaged by the flames, may give up.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: The SecurityCube for StarNet. It won't open without its P-Code!

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A Light Digital World Emitter. In case something happens in the real world, this emitter will preserve Cyberworld.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A great replica of a vending machine. The drinks are fake, but the product placement isn't...

property.name: Text 1
property.value: It's this terrible heat, that's causing the garbage on the lower level to waft a sickening aroma. Who's idea was it to invite fire navis anyway?

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Once the heat is down, I can return home. The large flames block all movement and traffic.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: This is the Business Area. It lives up to its name. You pick a creed, and you stick together. But in this current situation, I'd suggest you take the quickest route home. The flames have appeared recently. They won't dissolve until the responsible navi is deleted, so cleaning them is like drying clothes on a rainy day. Or shoveling amidst a storm - you get the picture. Business Area is huge. The Golden road is the fastest route out of here. There are, fortunately, a lot of alternate routes... But be wary, there are viruses around here. Use your Map appropriately to plan a route.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: This is the Business Square. It's only relatively safe... What? Digi-World emitter? I've no clue what you-- OH yes! Uhh... It's not here. It's ... further ahead.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: I'M THE SECURITY PROGRAM FOR THIS HOME PAGE. COME CLOSER, AND I WILL BREAK EVERY SINGLE LINE OF CODE IN YOUR FACE.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Should we even stay in here? I mean, if we're all together, won't that make us all prime targets?

property.name: Text 1
property.value: To be honest, I just feel like taking advantage of this situation, and raid every link I see before it all calms down.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Hey, who's that? They look out of place. And I don't like it!

property.name: Text 1
property.value: I'll wait for the fires to cool off... I'm terrified of trying any road but the main road.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Don't care what you say. As soon as I get my counter, I'm opening shop here.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A digi-server with a partner. The hum radiates in harmony between the two.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: Potent humming noises emerge from this digi-server.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: The console commands a lot of servers in the area. Actually, it monitors their health. Conveniently, it uses progress bars for everything, and makes it simple to understand.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: If I dump trash data into this well... where does it end up?

property.name: Text 1
property.value: So, you made it this far. Fair warning, until further notice, there isn't going to be a lot of people down south. In fact, here's a tip. See that security cube, WAY to the south? There is no way around it. I don't know how to open it, who has the key, it just won't open.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: I like to come here to relax. I can vent all I want. Don't ask why, I just can.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Oh, hey, look! The fire is not aligned properly. Should I take this chance to explore the rest of the area? I hear it's a REAL maze with little in the ways of backtracking... I don't want to get lost!
